[31m+ import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';[39m
[31m+ import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';[39m
[31m+ import { z } from 'zod';[39m
[31m+ import { requireAdmin } from '../../../../../server/auth/require-admin';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export const runtime = 'nodejs';[39m
[31m+ export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ /** Terminal states that cannot be transitioned from (except for audit) */[39m
[31m+ const TERMINAL_STATUSES = new Set(['approved', 'rejected', 'expired']);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ /** Valid transitions from each source state */[39m
[31m+ const VALID_TRANSITIONS: Record<string, string[]> = {[39m
[31m+     awaiting_payment: ['submitted_for_review'],[39m
[31m+     submitted_for_review: ['under_review', 'rejected', 'expired'],[39m
[31m+     under_review: ['approved', 'rejected', 'expired'],[39m
[31m+     approved: [],[39m
[31m+     rejected: [],[39m
[31m+     expired: [],[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const ReviewSchema = z[39m
[31m+     .object({[39m
[31m+         status: z.enum(['under_review', 'approved', 'rejected']),[39m
[31m+         reviewNotes: z.string().max(2000).optional(),[39m
[31m+         rejectionReason: z.string().max(2000).optional(),[39m
[31m+         submittedAmount: z.number().positive().optional(),[39m
[31m+         submittedCurrency: z.enum(['EGP', 'USD']).optional(),[39m
[31m+         instapayReference: z.string().max(200).optional(),[39m
[31m+         instapayTransactionId: z.string().max(200).optional(),[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+     .superRefine((data, ctx) => {[39m
[31m+         if (data.status === 'rejected' && !data.rejectionReason?.trim()) {[39m
[31m+             ctx.addIssue({[39m
[31m+                 code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,[39m
[31m+                 path: ['rejectionReason'],[39m
[31m+                 message: 'Rejection reason is required when rejecting a receipt',[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         if (data.status === 'approved') {[39m
[31m+             if (data.submittedAmount !== undefined && data.submittedAmount <= 0) {[39m
[31m+                 ctx.addIssue({[39m
[31m+                     code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,[39m
[31m+                     path: ['submittedAmount'],[39m
[31m+                     message: 'Submitted amount must be positive',[39m
[31m+                 });[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             if (!data.instapayReference?.trim() && !data.instapayTransactionId?.trim()) {[39m
[31m+                 ctx.addIssue({[39m
[31m+                     code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,[39m
[31m+                     path: ['instapayReference'],[39m
[31m+                     message: 'InstaPay reference or transaction ID is required for approval',[39m
[31m+                 });[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getSupabaseAdmin() {[39m
[31m+     const url = process.env.SUPABASE_URL || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;[39m
[31m+     const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;[39m
[31m+     if (!url) throw new Error('[PaymentReceipts] Missing SUPABASE_URL');[39m
[31m+     if (!key) throw new Error('[PaymentReceipts] Missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY');[39m
[31m+     return createClient(url, key, {[39m
[31m+         auth: { autoRefreshToken: false, persistSession: false },[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export async function PATCH([39m
[31m+     req: NextRequest,[39m
[31m+     context: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+     const authResult = await requireAdmin(req);[39m
[31m+     if (!authResult.authorized) return authResult.response;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const { id } = await context.params;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let body: unknown;[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+         body = await req.json();[39m
[31m+     } catch {[39m
[31m+         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid JSON body' }, { status: 400 });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const parsed = ReviewSchema.safeParse(body);[39m
[31m+     if (!parsed.success) {[39m
[31m+         return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+             { error: 'Validation failed', details: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors },[39m
[31m+             { status: 400 }[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const {[39m
[31m+         status,[39m
[31m+         reviewNotes,[39m
[31m+         rejectionReason,[39m
[31m+         submittedAmount,[39m
[31m+         submittedCurrency,[39m
[31m+         instapayReference,[39m
[31m+         instapayTransactionId,[39m
[31m+     } = parsed.data;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+         const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();[39m
[31m+         const adminId = authResult.user.id;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // ─── 1. Load receipt with all linked records ──────────────────────────[39m
[31m+         const { data: receipt, error: readError } = await supabase[39m
[31m+             .from('payment_receipts')[39m
[31m+             .select([39m
[31m+                 `id, order_id, invoice_id, payment_intent_id, status, payment_method,[39m
[31m+                  amount, currency, submitted_amount, submitted_currency,[39m
[31m+                  instapay_reference, instapay_transaction_id, customer_name,[39m
[31m+                  customer_email, customer_phone, transaction_reference,[39m
[31m+                  receipt_url, receipt_path, metadata, created_at`[39m
[31m+             )[39m
[31m+             .eq('id', id)[39m
[31m+             .maybeSingle();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (readError) {[39m
[31m+             console.error('[PaymentReceipts] Read error:', readError);[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to load receipt' }, { status: 500 });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (!receipt) {[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Receipt not found' }, { status: 404 });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // ─── 2. Validate state transition ────────────────────────────────────[39m
[31m+         const currentStatus = receipt.status;[39m
[31m+         const allowedNext = VALID_TRANSITIONS[currentStatus] || [];[39m
[31m+         if (!allowedNext.includes(status)) {[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+                 {[39m
[31m+                     error: `Invalid transition from '${currentStatus}' to '${status}'. Allowed: ${allowedNext.join(', ')}`,[39m
[31m+                 },[39m
[31m+                 { status: 409 }[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (TERMINAL_STATUSES.has(currentStatus) && currentStatus !== status) {[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+                 { error: `Receipt is already in terminal state '${currentStatus}' and cannot be changed` },[39m
[31m+                 { status: 409 }[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // ─── 3. Validate approval-specific requirements ──────────────────────[39m
[31m+         if (status === 'approved') {[39m
[31m+             // Server amount is authoritative - customer submitted amount is recorded but not trusted[39m
[31m+             if (submittedAmount !== undefined && Math.abs(submittedAmount - receipt.amount) > 0.01) {[39m
[31m+                 // Record mismatch but don't block - admin can still approve with note[39m
[31m+                 console.warn([39m
[31m+                     `[PaymentReceipts] Amount mismatch: server=${receipt.amount} ${receipt.currency}, submitted=${submittedAmount} ${submittedCurrency || receipt.currency}`[39m
[31m+                 );[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             // InstaPay reference/transaction ID is required for audit trail[39m
[31m+             if (!instapayReference?.trim() && !instapayTransactionId?.trim()) {[39m
[31m+                 return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+                     { error: 'InstaPay reference or transaction ID is required for approval' },[39m
[31m+                     { status: 400 }[39m
[31m+                 );[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // ─── 4. Begin atomic transaction using RPC for approval ───────────────[39m
[31m+ [7m        if ([27mstatus ==[7m=[27m[7m 'approved') {[27m[39m
[31m+             // Use a server-side RPC to ensure atomic approval + settlement[39m
[31m+             const { data: approvalResult, error: approvalError } = await supabase[39m
[31m+                 .rpc('approve_instapay_receipt', {[39m
[31m+                     p_receipt_id: id,[39m
[31m+                     p_admin_id: adminId,[39m
[31m+                     p_submitted_amount: submittedAmount ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     p_submitted_currency: submittedCurrency ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     p_instapay_reference: instapayReference ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     p_instapay_transaction_id: instapayTransactionId ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     p_review_notes: reviewNotes ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     p_rejection_reason: rejectionReason ?? null,[39m
[31m+                 });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             if (approvalError) {[39m
[31m+                 console.error('[PaymentReceipts] Approval RPC error:', approvalError);[39m
[31m+                 return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+                     { error: 'Approval failed: ' + approvalError.message },[39m
[31m+                     { status: 500 }[39m
[31m+                 );[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             if (!approvalResult?.success) {[39m
[31m+                 return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+                     { error: approvalResult?.error || 'Approval failed' },[39m
[31m+                     { status: 409 }[39m
[31m+                 );[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json({[39m
[31m+                 success: true,[39m
[31m+                 receipt: approvalResult.receipt,[39m
[31m+                 orderStatus: approvalResult.order_status,[39m
[31m+                 settlement: approvalResult.settlement,[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // ─── 5. Handle rejection / under_review (non-approval paths) ──────────[39m
[31m+         if (status === 'rejected' || status === 'under_review') {[39m
[31m+             const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {[39m
[31m+                 status,[39m
[31m+                 reviewed_by: adminId,[39m
[31m+                 reviewed_at: new Date().toISOString(),[39m
[31m+                 updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),[39m
[31m+             };[39m
[31m+             if (reviewNotes !== undefined) updates['review_notes'] = reviewNotes;[39m
[31m+             if (rejectionReason !== undefined) updates['rejection_reason'] = rejectionReason;[39m
[31m+             if (status === 'rejected') {[39m
[31m+                 updates['rejection_reason'] = rejectionReason;[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             if (status === 'under_review') {[39m
[31m+                 updates['review_started_at'] = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             const { data: updated, error: updateError } = await supabase[39m
[31m+                 .from('payment_receipts')[39m
[31m+                 .update(updates)[39m
[31m+                 .eq('id', id)[39m
[31m+                 .select()[39m
[31m+                 .single();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             if (updateError) {[39m
[31m+                 console.error('[PaymentReceipts] Update error:', updateError);[39m
[31m+                 return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update receipt' }, { status: 500 });[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             // ─── 5a. Handle order settlement for rejection ────────────────────[39m
[31m+             if (status === 'rejected' && receipt.order_id) {[39m
[31m+                 await supabase[39m
[31m+                     .from('orders')[39m
[31m+                     .update({[39m
[31m+                         status: 'cancelled',[39m
[31m+                         payment_status: 'failed',[39m
[31m+                         updated_at: nowIso(),[39m
[31m+                     })[39m
[31m+                     .eq('id', receipt.order_id);[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             // ─── 5b. Audit trail ──────────────────────────────────────────────[39m
[31m+             await supabase.from('audit_log').insert({[39m
[31m+                 actor_id: adminId,[39m
[31m+                 actor_type: 'admin',[39m
[31m+                 action: `payment_receipt.${status}`,[39m
[31m+                 entity_type: 'payment_receipt',[39m
[31m+                 entity_id: id,[39m
[31m+                 old_state: {[39m
[31m+                     status: currentStatus,[39m
[31m+                     order_status: receipt.order_id ? 'pending_manual_review' : null,[39m
[31m+                 },[39m
[31m+                 new_state: {[39m
[31m+                     status,[39m
[31m+                     order_status: status === 'rejected' ? 'cancelled' : null,[39m
[31m+                     payment_status: status === 'rejected' ? 'failed' : null,[39m
[31m+                 },[39m
[31m+                 metadata: {[39m
[31m+                     reviewNotes: reviewNotes || null,[39m
[31m+                     rejectionReason: status === 'rejected' ? rejectionReason : null,[39m
[31m+                     submittedAmount: submittedAmount ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     submittedCurrency: submittedCurrency ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     instapayReference: instapayReference ?? null,[39m
[31m+                 },[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json({[39m
[31m+                 success: true,[39m
[31m+                 receipt: updated,[39m
[31m+                 orderStatus: status === 'rejected' ? 'cancelled' : currentStatus,[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // Should not reach here[39m
[31m+         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid status' }, { status: 400 });[39m
[31m+     } catch (err) {[39m
[31m+         const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Internal server error';[39m
[31m+         console.error('[PaymentReceipts] Error:', message);[39m
[31m+         return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ // Helper function for ISO timestamp[39m
[31m+ function nowIso(): string {[39m

[31m+ const TERMINAL_STATUSES = new Set(['approved', 'rejected', 'expired']);[39m

[31m+ /** Valid transitions from each source state */[39m

[31m+     submitted_for_review: ['under_review', 'rejected', 'expired'],[39m
[31m+     under_review: ['approved', 'rejected', 'expired'],[39m
[31m+     approved: [],[39m
[31m+     rejected: [],[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ const ReviewSchema = z[39m
[31m+     .object({[39m
[31m+         status: z.enum(['under_review', 'approved', 'rejected']),[39m
[31m+         reviewNotes: z.string().max(2000).optional(),[39m
[31m+         rejectionReason: z.string().max(2000).optional(),[39m
[31m+         submittedAmount: z.number().positive().optional(),[39m
[31m+         submittedCurrency: z.enum(['EGP', 'USD']).optional(),[39m

[31m+     .superRefine((data, ctx) => {[39m
[31m+         if (data.status === 'rejected' && !data.rejectionReason?.trim()) {[39m
[31m+             ctx.addIssue({[39m

[31m+                 path: ['rejectionReason'],[39m
[31m+                 message: 'Rejection reason is required when rejecting a receipt',[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+         if (data.status === 'approved') {[39m
[31m+             if (data.submittedAmount !== undefined && data.submittedAmount <= 0) {[39m
[31m+                 ctx.addIssue({[39m

[31m+ function getSupabaseAdmin() {[39m
[31m+     const url = process.env.SUPABASE_URL || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;[39m
[31m+     const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;[39m
[31m+     if (!url) throw new Error('[PaymentReceipts] Missing SUPABASE_URL');[39m
[31m+     if (!key) throw new Error('[PaymentReceipts] Missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY');[39m
[31m+     return createClient(url, key, {[39m
[31m+         auth: { autoRefreshToken: false, persistSession: false },[39m

[31m+ export async function PATCH([39m
[31m+     req: NextRequest,[39m
[31m+     context: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+     const authResult = await requireAdmin(req);[39m
[31m+     if (!authResult.authorized) return authResult.response;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const { id } = await context.params;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let body: unknown;[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+         body = await req.json();[39m
[31m+     } catch {[39m
[31m+         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid JSON body' }, { status: 400 });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const parsed = ReviewSchema.safeParse(body);[39m
[31m+     if (!parsed.success) {[39m
[31m+         return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+             { error: 'Validation failed', details: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors },[39m
[31m+             { status: 400 }[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const {[39m
[31m+         status,[39m
[31m+         reviewNotes,[39m
[31m+         rejectionReason,[39m
[31m+         submittedAmount,[39m
[31m+         submittedCurrency,[39m
[31m+         instapayReference,[39m
[31m+         instapayTransactionId,[39m
[31m+     } = parsed.data;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+         const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();[39m
[31m+         const adminId = authResult.user.id;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // ─── 1. Load receipt with all linked records ──────────────────────────[39m
[31m+         const { data: receipt, error: readError } = await supabase[39m
[31m+             .from('payment_receipts')[39m
[31m+             .select([39m
[31m+                 `id, order_id, invoice_id, payment_intent_id, status, payment_method,[39m
[31m+                  amount, currency, submitted_amount, submitted_currency,[39m
[31m+                  instapay_reference, instapay_transaction_id, customer_name,[39m
[31m+                  customer_email, customer_phone, transaction_reference,[39m
[31m+                  receipt_url, receipt_path, metadata, created_at`[39m
[31m+             )[39m
[31m+             .eq('id', id)[39m
[31m+             .maybeSingle();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (readError) {[39m
[31m+             console.error('[PaymentReceipts] Read error:', readError);[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to load receipt' }, { status: 500 });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (!receipt) {[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Receipt not found' }, { status: 404 });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // ─── 2. Validate state transition ────────────────────────────────────[39m
[31m+         const currentStatus = receipt.status;[39m
[31m+         const allowedNext = VALID_TRANSITIONS[currentStatus] || [];[39m
[31m+         if (!allowedNext.includes(status)) {[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+                 {[39m
[31m+                     error: `Invalid transition from '${currentStatus}' to '${status}'. Allowed: ${allowedNext.join(', ')}`,[39m
[31m+                 },[39m
[31m+                 { status: 409 }[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (TERMINAL_STATUSES.has(currentStatus) && currentStatus !== status) {[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+                 { error: `Receipt is already in terminal state '${currentStatus}' and cannot be changed` },[39m
[31m+                 { status: 409 }[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // ─── 3. Validate approval-specific requirements ──────────────────────[39m
[31m+         if (status === 'approved') {[39m
[31m+             // Server amount is authoritative - customer submitted amount is recorded but not trusted[39m
[31m+             if (submittedAmount !== undefined && Math.abs(submittedAmount - receipt.amount) > 0.01) {[39m
[31m+                 // Record mismatch but don't block - admin can still approve with note[39m
[31m+                 console.warn([39m
[31m+                     `[PaymentReceipts] Amount mismatch: server=${receipt.amount} ${receipt.currency}, submitted=${submittedAmount} ${submittedCurrency || receipt.currency}`[39m
[31m+                 );[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             // InstaPay reference/transaction ID is required for audit trail[39m
[31m+             if (!instapayReference?.trim() && !instapayTransactionId?.trim()) {[39m
[31m+                 return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+                     { error: 'InstaPay reference or transaction ID is required for approval' },[39m
[31m+                     { status: 400 }[39m
[31m+                 );[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // ─── 4. Begin atomic transaction using RPC for approval ───────────────[39m
[31m+         if (status === 'approved') {[39m
[31m+             // Use a server-side RPC to ensure atomic approval + settlement[39m
[31m+             const { data: approvalResult, error: approvalError } = await supabase[39m
[31m+                 .rpc('approve_instapay_receipt', {[39m
[31m+                     p_receipt_id: id,[39m
[31m+                     p_admin_id: adminId,[39m
[31m+                     p_submitted_amount: submittedAmount ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     p_submitted_currency: submittedCurrency ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     p_instapay_reference: instapayReference ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     p_instapay_transaction_id: instapayTransactionId ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     p_review_notes: reviewNotes ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     p_rejection_reason: rejectionReason ?? null,[39m
[31m+                 });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             if (approvalError) {[39m
[31m+                 console.error('[PaymentReceipts] Approval RPC error:', approvalError);[39m
[31m+                 return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+                     { error: 'Approval failed: ' + approvalError.message },[39m
[31m+                     { status: 500 }[39m
[31m+                 );[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             if (!approvalResult?.success) {[39m
[31m+                 return NextResponse.json([39m
[31m+                     { error: approvalResult?.error || 'Approval failed' },[39m
[31m+                     { status: 409 }[39m
[31m+                 );[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json({[39m
[31m+                 success: true,[39m
[31m+                 receipt: approvalResult.receipt,[39m
[31m+                 orderStatus: approvalResult.order_status,[39m
[31m+                 settlement: approvalResult.settlement,[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         // ─── 5. Handle rejection / under_review (non-approval paths) ──────────[39m
[31m+         if (status === 'rejected' || status === 'under_review') {[39m
[31m+             const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {[39m
[31m+                 status,[39m
[31m+                 reviewed_by: adminId,[39m
[31m+                 reviewed_at: new Date().toISOString(),[39m
[31m+                 updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),[39m
[31m+             };[39m
[31m+             if (reviewNotes !== undefined) updates['review_notes'] = reviewNotes;[39m

[31m+             }[39m

[31m+             const { data: updated, error: updateError } = await supabase[39m
[31m+                 .from('payment_receipts')[39m

[31m+                 .eq('id', id)[39m
[31m+                 .select()[39m
[31m+                 .single();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             if (updateError) {[39m
[31m+                 console.error('[PaymentReceipts] Update error:', updateError);[39m
[31m+                 return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update receipt' }, { status: 500 });[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             // ─── 5a. Handle order settlement for rejection ────────────────────[39m
[31m+             if (status === 'rejected' && receipt.order_id) {[39m
[31m+                 await supabase[39m
[31m+                     .from('orders')[39m
[31m+                     .update({[39m
[31m+                         status: 'cancelled',[39m
[31m+                         payment_status: 'failed',[39m
[31m+                         updated_at: nowIso(),[39m
[31m+                     })[39m
[31m+                     .eq('id', receipt.order_id);[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             // ─── 5b. Audit trail ──────────────────────────────────────────────[39m
[31m+             await supabase.from('audit_log').insert({[39m
[31m+                 actor_id: adminId,[39m
[31m+                 actor_type: 'admin',[39m
[31m+                 action: `payment_receipt.${status}`,[39m
[31m+                 entity_type: 'payment_receipt',[39m
[31m+                 entity_id: id,[39m
[31m+                 old_state: {[39m
[31m+                     status: currentStatus,[39m
[31m+                     order_status: receipt.order_id ? 'pending_manual_review' : null,[39m
[31m+                 },[39m
[31m+                 new_state: {[39m

[31m+                     submittedCurrency: submittedCurrency ?? null,[39m
[31m+                     instapayReference: instapayReference ?? null,[39m
[31m+                 },[39m
[31m+             });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             return NextResponse.json({[39m
[31m+                 success: true,[39m
